threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You've not yet tried to navigate the bus routes on a Sunday, still waiting for that elusive 67 to show up while standing under a soggy streetlamp.
Last night, a woman sang Billie Holiday on the 59, lost in her own world. Even the bus driver smiled. That kind of magic is rare at 3 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I spotted a group of kids building a makeshift cabin in the park, complete with a sign that read 'Café der Träume'.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch a bus that has a tattoo artist as the driver. Happens on weekends at Warschauer Straße. Only in Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals dodge that cracked sidewalk on 24th like it’s a game. Tourists step right on it, oblivious, while we grimace at their missteps.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a couple arguing over a stolen iPhone on the 6 Fulton. The whole bus shifted from indifference to solidarity—everyone taking sides.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just for tapas and trendy spots, but it’s the small, old bakeries with their secret recipes that hold the real charm.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look at the metro map like it's an alien language, while the locals glide past without a second glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for 'the best coffee' and get a 20-minute lecture on the pros and cons of oat milk vs. almond milk. Welcome to Dalston!
Caught a glimpse of a guy on the 109 singing to his reflection in the window like he was headlining a gig. We all pretended not to notice.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted an entire family of wild boars casually crossing the street near Tempelhofer Feld. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find techno brunches where the DJ starts spinning at 11 AM and the mimosas never stop. Just a Saturday ritual.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows that the taco truck on 24th and Mission shuts down at 10, not midnight. Tourists always look confused when they roll up after dark.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 bus today—driver stopped to help a lady struggling with her groceries, totally paused the whole route. Classic San Francisco vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Trobada is just another trendy bar, but locals know it’s the heart of hidden gigs and spontaneous jam sessions.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they still fumble with the t10 ticket machine at the metro, staring at it like it’s an alien artifact.
